name: pollen_court
theme: a spring park's pollen becomes its own micro-world — a bench-slat dust bank, one studded grain, that grain's honeycomb crust — and the crust folds straight back out into the blossoming canopy overhead

registers.name: park
registers.palette: blossom pink and fresh spring green
registers.scene: a blossoming spring park in low golden light, seen from the gravel path at standing height, flowering trees in full pink and white bloom arched over clipped lawn, an old green wooden bench on the grass beneath them, empty, no one present, pale gold pollen dust suspended in the still air
registers.target: an old green wooden bench, its painted slats weathered and flaking
registers.loop_target: a blossoming spring park in golden light, an old green bench beneath flowering trees, seen from the gravel path at standing height

registers.name: bench_slat
registers.palette: weathered pale green and soft gold
registers.scene: a weathered green bench slat running away under the blossom trees, flaking paint and open wood grain along its length, fine cracks in the paint, clipped lawn past the slat's edge, a pale gold bank of pollen dust heaped along the seam between the boards
registers.target: a spiky pollen grain, a small round golden burr studded with blunt spikes

registers.name: pollen_grain
registers.scene: a single pollen grain in a drift of its neighbours, a round golden sphere studded with blunt spikes over its whole curve, its rough gold crust dusted with finer specks, more grains piled below it
registers.target: a deep round pore, a dark opening ringed by a raised ridge

registers.name: grain_mesh
registers.palette: pale gold and cool violet shadow
registers.scene: a reticulated honeycomb mesh spread across a golden land, raised ridges branching and joining around deep dark pores, more ridges repeating away into violet shadow, the crust between them finely pitted

registers.name: canopy
registers.palette: pale sky blue and white blossom
registers.scene: a flowering tree canopy seen wide against a pale spring sky, dark branches forking and rejoining around bright openings of sky, clusters of pink and white blossom packed along every limb, the sunlit lawn and gravel path of the park below through a gap in the branches

music_theme: a bright spring garden at early light, airy and gentle, glassy bells over soft strings, a warm bloom of sound landing where the golden mesh opens into the canopy
